metadata.note: FP at bot: boxtimes(bot)=bot means the inconsistency proof is self-referential.
metadata.long_description: G2=F FG2=T FP=T. FG2 and syntactic FP, but G2 fails. The FP is at bot itself: boxtimes(bot)=bot. FG2 holds because boxtimes^2(T)=boxtimes(bot)=bot=boxtimes(T). nFG2(k) holds for all k (orbit of T stabilizes at bot).
